business_problem: BIGO needed better recommendation-model training, large-scale storage, and elastic infrastructure that could absorb live-streaming spikes and global short-video traffic without costly manual overprovisioning.
solution_summary: BIGO moved key workloads onto Tencent Cloud so its live-streaming and short-video products could scale globally without overbuilding fixed capacity. Tencent Cloud provides the high-performance foundation for BIGO's online and offline big-data platforms, which support recommendation-model training and the platform's massive storage requirements. Cloud resources are combined with automatic scaling and traffic-scheduling services so live events, short-video bursts, and other sudden concurrency spikes can be absorbed without emergency capacity buys. Tencent also links data centers with dedicated TB-class private lines for low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnection, adds cross-availability-zone backup, and supports minute-level cluster deployment compatible with open-source stacks. The result is a globally distributed media platform that can serve hundreds of millions of users while optimizing both latency and infrastructure cost.

solution_components.role: Places and routes workloads quickly across clusters to meet latency and burst requirements.
